defect.summary: tools/nomos_run_vectors.py iterated vector['actions']. A vector declaring any other shape iterated zero times, produced zero failures, and was reported PASS.
defect.rootCause: _run_vector used vector.get('actions', []) with no validation that the vector actually declared an executable sequence.
defect.proof: A vector whose 'steps' key contained an impossible assertion reported PASS. The identical assertion under 'actions' reported FAIL with the real outcome.
defect.significance: An unexecuted vector was indistinguishable from a passing one, so no green vector result could be trusted. This is an evidence-integrity defect, not a lint issue.

behaviour: vector with no 'actions' key -> FAIL, error names the vector id and the keys it did declare
empty 'actions' list -> FAIL (empty executable sequence cannot be reported PASS)
'steps' -> explicitly rejected, error states the supported key is 'actions'
fix.invariant: the runner never reports PASS for a vector it did not execute

covers: impossible assertion under actions IS caught

sweep.note: every corpus in primitives/*/vectors/ re-run after hardening

reclassification.now: reports FAIL with an explicit schema error
reclassification.assessment: Claim Verification's CAPABILITY reproduce list does NOT invoke nomos_run_vectors.py; its declared evidence is pytest plus genvm-lint, both unaffected. Its CONFORMANT status does NOT rest on these vectors and stands.
reclassification.newStatus: EVIDENCE_REVIEW_REQUIRED for this corpus only; the corpus is not executable by this runner and must not be cited as vector evidence.
reclassification.hazardClosed: a reader can no longer obtain a false green by pointing this runner at it

reclassification.now: reports FAIL with an explicit 'steps' rejection
reclassification.assessment: Superseded by v0.3-origin.json. Additionally these vectors encode v0.2 behaviour in which the owner supplied receipts from the unregistered placeholder 0xabc000000000000000000000000000000000001, so they cannot pass under v0.3 origin binding even after migration.
reclassification.newStatus: NOT_INDEPENDENTLY_TRUSTED and superseded; not migrated, because migrating them would encode a behaviour v0.3 deliberately removed

verifiedUnaffected.note: All 12 primitives that declare nomos_run_vectors.py in their CAPABILITY reproduce list use the 'actions' key and executed their assertions. All still pass after hardening: adjudicated-receipt 5/5, capital-commitment 16/16, claim-encumbrance 16/16, daa 11/11, dal 10/10, financial-contract 9/9, gaia 9/9, mandate-allocation 9/9, policy-envelope 12/12, ppa v0.1 15/15, ppa v0.3-origin 9/9, proof-of-payable 17/17, workflow-authorization 10/10.
verifiedUnaffected.conclusion: No previously-valid vector evidence was invalidated by this fix.

residual: The runner still cannot execute SEMANTIC/judgment-bearing corpora that use a claim/evidence/expected schema. Claim Verification needs its own harness or a migration to 'actions'. Tracked, not fixed here.
ppa v0.2-spine remains in the active vectors directory and will FAIL if explicitly run. That is intentional: it must not report green. Removing it is a separate decision about historical artifacts.
